name: Sacrifice Sanctuary
desc:
Compete against 11 other contestants in a deadly competition to live and be the one to walk away free from the Sacrifice Sanctuary.

🩸 Compete in many different types of competitions
👑 Win daily matches to unlock exclusive crowns and streak rewards
💀 Reach Level 5 to enter the Basement Battle mode
💰 Earn Zips from every challenge and spend them in the shop

Join the ZELZ Roblox group and community server for updates about development and related news!
